content.inline:
## Connections
Connections are provider skills layered over shared transports; loading one appends its instructions and tools to the agent's existing frame. Use `v/ops/connections/list` to see provider descriptors and transport availability, then `v/ops/connections/status` to check whether your user namespace has a named credential. Status checks encrypted-record presence only and never reads the value.

Load the provider skill before using a service. It gives the base URL, exact `s/NAME` reference, API conventions, and shared HTTP tools. Loading a skill grants no authority: normal invoke and secret-resolution capability checks still apply. Never copy a token into a prompt or ordinary header; pass only the provider skill's secret reference through the transport's credential field. A missing credential is setup work, not permission to invent or request plaintext in chat.
